summary: CIBC filed a Form 6-K attaching a news release announcing the appointment of Bill Morneau, an independent director since 2022 and former Canadian finance minister, as Chair of the Board effective January 1, 2027. He succeeds Katharine B. Stevenson, who retires from the Board December 31, 2026, after six years as Chair and ten years as an independent director. No terms, consideration, advisors or regulatory approvals are involved. The change is a planned, orderly board succession rather than a forced or abrupt departure, so it falls outside the usual special-situations read; watch governance continuity and any incremental strategic shift under new board leadership.
